name: source-arrow-fields
goal: Exclude typed callback declarations from executable source blocks and complexity.

evidence: Independent review ran real sourceBlocks on pinned Workspace blobs and found callback declarations parsed as executable properties, double-counting later decisions. The current property matcher treats the equals of a type arrow as initialization and scans beyond a nested type. Preserve real initialized arrow fields.

Extend existing test/utils/source-blocks.test.ts with callback declarations, initialized fields and typed/generic function annotations. Assert exact named blocks and complexity; current tests cover normal functions, methods and Svelte regions but omit typed callback fields.
